content.subject: Month‑end close and manual matching
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,
Your appointment as CFO highlights a strategic push on finance operations. In fintech, month‑end close drags because reconciliation depends on manual matching across legacy rails. That delay forces finance teams to allocate hours that support analysis. That friction is where we focus.
Our team creates a feed that consolidates transaction streams into a single ledger for automatic matching.
Is manual reconciliation a significant bottleneck for your month‑end close?
